name: SentinelOne recruiting-pipeline targeting

attribution.legal_posture: Security-vendor research finding; legal identity and adjudication remain outside the finding.

caveats: SentinelOne describes intelligence-driven interaction with candidates; the project records the source description only, with engagement reproduction and extension outside scope.
The counts cover applications/personas directed at SentinelOne; the reported stage is recruitment rather than successful hiring.

statements: SentinelOne said it tracked roughly 360 fake personas and more than 1,000 applications linked to DPRK IT-worker operations targeting SentinelOne roles.
Applications included intelligence-engineering positions in SentinelLabs, and the company observed referral requests directed to strategic employees.
SentinelOne integrated recruiting signals into its intelligence workflow to identify anomalous applicant patterns.
